_llm_instructions: Populate the fields of 'CHANGE LOG' and write the value of each field under 'Generated Value', based on the project context. Context: the project carrying reference PMO-05.04.

f01_ID.label: ID
f01_ID.guidance: Unique identifier for the change request (e.g., CR-01).

f02_Category.label: Category
f02_Category.guidance: Change category (Scope, Schedule, Cost, Quality, Resource).

f03_Description.label: Description
f03_Description.guidance: Summary description of the proposed change.

f04_Requestor.label: Requestor
f04_Requestor.guidance: Name or department submitting the change request.

f05_Submission_Date.label: Submission Date
f05_Submission_Date.guidance: Date the change request was formally submitted.

f06_Status.label: Status
f06_Status.guidance: Current lifecycle state of the request (Submitted, Under Review, Approved, Rejected).

f07_Disposition.label: Disposition
f07_Disposition.guidance: Decision made by the Change Control Board (CCB).

f08_Cost_Schedule_Impact.label: Cost/Schedule Impact
f08_Cost_Schedule_Impact.guidance: Estimated financial and timeline impact of the change.

f09_Type_Mandatory_Discretionary.label: Type (Mandatory/Discretionary)
f09_Type_Mandatory_Discretionary.guidance: Whether the change is legally mandatory or discretionary.

f10_Configurable_Items_Impacted.label: Configurable Items Impacted
f10_Configurable_Items_Impacted.guidance: Configuration items, baselines, or specifications affected.
